decisions.title: Expand Forest Restoration to Three New Sites
decisions.rationale: Current forest missions have achieved 85% survival rate, demonstrating operational capability. Expansion will increase impact and test scalability of our approach.
alternativesConsidered: Focus on improving existing sites only
Expand to only one new site as a pilot
Partner with another organization for expansion
assumptions: Current operational model is transferable to new sites
Volunteer capacity can scale with expansion
Funding will be available for three sites
risksIdentified: Operational complexity may exceed current capacity
New sites may have different environmental conditions
Volunteer recruitment may not keep pace

decisions.title: Adopt Heritage Preservation Policy
decisions.rationale: Heritage assets require systematic preservation approach. Policy establishes clear procedures for assessment, documentation, and conservation.
alternativesConsidered: Develop guidelines instead of formal policy
Partner with heritage organizations for preservation
assumptions: Formal policy will improve preservation outcomes
Funding for preservation activities will be available
risksIdentified: Policy may be too rigid for diverse heritage assets

lessons.title: Community Engagement Improves Survival Rates
lessons.description: Forest missions with active community engagement achieved 90% survival rate vs 75% without engagement.
lessons.context: Three forest missions were compared over 12 months. Two had structured community engagement programs, one did not.
lessons.recommendation: Include community engagement as a standard component of all forest missions.

lessons.title: Policy Implementation Requires Training
lessons.description: Policies implemented without accompanying training had 40% lower compliance rates.
lessons.context: Analysis of three policy implementations over 18 months showed correlation between training and compliance.
lessons.recommendation: Always include training component when implementing new policies.

patterns.name: Phased Expansion
patterns.description: Successful mission expansion follows a phased approach: pilot, validate, scale.
